verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tool-execution and integration platform like Pipedream MCP, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents individual tool calls, managed auth, transports, and an API proxy. Nothing describes batch or bulk actions across many items at once. Loading all available tools into a client is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
